# Retire obsolete browser skips from Node grid unit specs

## Context

Review of merged PR #20394 found the same historical browser skip in twelve other grid unit specs. That repair exposed a real teardown regression hidden by `NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI`; its [hosted unit job](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/42124748511/job/127586001237) executes the repaired destruction and genuine-error cases.

## The Problem

At `8d70e70a27`, `rg -n 'test.skip.*NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI' test/playwright/unit/grid` finds thirteen skip statements across twelve files, all claiming “bucket B: Grid tests require Playwright browsers in CI”. They suppress coverage whenever the unit job sets that flag.

Scope (paths relative to `test/playwright/unit/grid/`): `DeferredViewData.spec.mjs:33`, `AriaRegions.spec.mjs:110`, `LockedSubGridConfigs.spec.mjs:96`, `AnimateRowsContentSized.spec.mjs:118`, `LockedColumns.spec.mjs:44`, `Teleportation.spec.mjs:27`, `WrapTextMeasure.spec.mjs:214,757`, `ScrollFlightMerge.spec.mjs:37`, `Pooling.spec.mjs:54`, `AnchorCorrection.spec.mjs:98`, `ColumnResizeCellSync.spec.mjs:125`, `RowGeometry.spec.mjs:342`.

The full local unit suite passed during the preceding repair (6,075 passed, 2 skipped). This is evidence to revalidate the exclusions, **not** proof that these twelve files already execute under hosted CI flags.

## The Architectural Reality

These are Engine unit specs under the Node single-thread simulation, whose canonical setup is `test/playwright/setup.mjs` and config is `test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs`. The work belongs to test capability assumptions and fixture lifetime, not CI tier selection.

Design authority: the [unit-testing guide](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/guides/testing/UnitTesting.md) defines the simulation; the original audit #10903 explicitly rejected hiding failures with skips. Its browser-requirement hypothesis must now be checked against each current spec.

## The Fix

Audit the listed guards, prove which specs need no browser fixture, and remove obsolete exclusions. Repair any narrowly scoped fixture/teardown defects exposed by executing those tests. Preserve a genuine capability guard only with a concrete dependency and reason.

Use the explicit unit config with `CI=true NEO_TEST_SKIP_CI=true`; do not unset the flag as the fix. Document each guard's disposition in the PR.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All thirteen guards in the twelve listed files have a source-backed capability disposition.
- [ ] Each Node-only case runs under CI flags without a browser fixture; meaningful assertions and teardown remain intact.
- [ ] Any retained guard identifies the real missing capability and its evidence.
- [ ] The exact PR head's hosted unit log shows every newly enabled arm as executed (`✓`), not skipped (`-`); link the log and list the affected arms.
- [ ] The explicit-config unit suite passes; failures exposed by removal are fixed or separately tracked with their reproduction, never silently re-skipped.

## Out of Scope

CI classifier/job-selection work in #20328, browser e2e redesign, and unrelated production grid changes. `AnimateRowsSteps.spec.mjs` is already repaired by #20394.

## Avoided Traps

A green job is not evidence of execution. Installing browsers cannot validate a test that stays skipped. Blanket removal without checking dependencies merely replaces an untested assumption with another.

## Related

Follow-up discovered by #20393 / PR #20394; historical rationale #10903. Standalone coverage leaf, not a child of #20328.
